N1.s: %lld cutling percuma sudah habis. Teruskan di Cutling untuk membuka kunci, dan cutling ini akan disimpan.
N1.back: 5 cutling free already used-up. Continue in Cutling to open lock, and cutling this will be-saved.
N1.why: "Teruskan" is the vocabulary's continue word, so the prompt names the same step as the button iOS shows under it; "habis" and "di Cutling" are from K1; the item is the subject of "akan disimpan" because the app saves it, not the person; 102 characters.

N2.s: %lld cutling percuma sudah habis. Buka kunci di Cutling untuk terus menyimpan.
N2.back: 5 cutling free already used-up. Open lock in Cutling to keep saving.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; "Buka kunci di Cutling" is K1's phrase and says where to go without a second "buka"; "terus menyimpan" echoes the sheet's title "Teruskan menyimpan"; 75 characters.

N3.why: "tinggal satu" is how Malaysians say one is left; the digit reads faster in a key-tall capsule and matches the numbers in N4; 27 characters.

N4.why: Uses the S5 and S21 words so the count reads the same everywhere, and 5 of 5 says full on its own; "percuma penuh" would read as "completely free"; used-then-total order, so plain %lld; exactly 30 characters.

N5.s: %lld/%lld percuma. Buka kunci untuk simpan ini
N5.back: 5/5 free. Open lock to save this
N5.why: The slash pair from S29 shows the places are full in three characters; "simpan ini" is the spoken "save this" and tells them the item they were saving is not lost; exactly 40 characters.

N6.why: The same button verb as S15; exactly 10 characters.

N7.s: %lld cutling percuma sudah habis. Buka kunci Cutling dan yang ini akan disimpan untuk anda.
N7.back: 5 cutling free already used-up. Open lock Cutling and the-one this will be-saved for you.
N7.why: Same first sentence as N1 and N2; "yang ini" points at the item in the form above it; "untuk anda" says Cutling saves it for them, in the vocabulary's "anda"; 88 characters.

N8.s: Apa yang anda kongsi sedang menunggu. Buka kunci di Cutling untuk menyimpannya.
N8.back: What that you share is waiting. Open lock in Cutling to save-it.
N8.why: "kongsi" is iOS Malay for Share, so the line names what they just did; "menunggu" says the item is kept without a second "simpan", which would blur kept and saved; opening a sentence with "Cutling ini" would look like the app's name; 79 characters.
